verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a GPU with ROCm/PyTorch library access for AI workloads and a separate consumer AMD Software GUI for driver/gaming features (HYPR-RX, Anti-Lag, FSR); there's no SaaS-style product UI whose functionality would need to be mirrored via an API for AI-native users. This UI/API parity story is a category error for a hardware/driver-stack product rather than an applicable, unmet axis.
